explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/193 with the negative answer of Cambie–Kalviainen (formal proof linked). It negates: for every finite step set S ⊆ ℤ³, every S-walk with infinite range contains three distinct collinear points (collinearity over ℚ). The infinite-range requirement is a sensible reading of 'infinite S-walk A = {a_1, a_2, …}', and the in-line comment explains it.
